annotations.title: Pre-flight x402 security audit & prompt-injection detector

description: [$0.002] Pre-flight x402 endpoint security firewall & prompt-injection detector. Probes any URL unpaid to catch price spikes, SIWx spoofing, fake USDC, and prompt injections ($0.002/call). Do not use for EVM calldata simulation (use evm_tx_simulate) or token bytecode scans (use token_honeypot_scan). `method` sets the HTTP probe verb (`GET` vs `POST`) used to trigger the 402 header, `deep_audit=true` runs prompt-injection checks, and `max_acceptable_usd` caps price validation. Live HTTP probe, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.
